attr.title: Digital Tamers 2
attr.desc: The sequel to Digital Tamers: ReBorn. Raise, train, and evolve your partner across more than 150 challenges, almost 100 unique quests, and over 600 different Digimon to collect, with dynamic combat, rich map exploration, and engaging stories.
attr.inst: Download the Android version from https://dragonrod342.itch.io/digital-tamers-2 and add the .apk to `digitaltamers2/assets`.
